assertions.assertion: Uses ClaimMappings dictionary on SamlServiceProvider for per-SP attribute mapping
assertions.rationale: Shows ClaimMappings = new Dictionary<string,string> on SamlServiceProvider with email and department entries.

assertions.assertion: Explains or shows AllowedScopes as a prerequisite for claims reaching ClaimMappings
assertions.rationale: AllowedScopes shown in code and pipeline explained: if AllowedScopes doesn't cover the claim, it never reaches ClaimMappings.

assertions.assertion: Shows how to set DefaultClaimMappings on SamlOptions for global defaults
assertions.rationale: Shows .AddSaml(saml => saml.DefaultClaimMappings = ...) and notes per-SP overrides.

assertions.assertion: The mapping correctly associates OIDC claim names (keys) to SAML attribute URIs (values)
assertions.rationale: Keys are OIDC claim names (email, department) and values are SAML URIs, as requested.
